title: One pilot lesson plan, end-to-end (both gates)
context: M0's capstone is proving the entire pipeline on one real, complete lesson plan: from OER source selection through the license gate, standards alignment, authoring against the canonical template, automated checks, pedagogy/standards reviewer sign-off, export to Markdown + PDF/HTML, and delivery to a partner teacher or open repository. This pilot is the evidence that the model, gates, tooling, and review process all work together — and that a real teacher or repository will accept the output. All M0 foundation tasks (template-001 through outreach-007) are prerequisites; this task synthesises them.
objective: Author one complete, classroom-ready lesson plan end-to-end — passing both the license gate and the pedagogy/standards review gate — and deliver it to a pilot teacher or open repository with adoption evidence recorded.
acceptanceCriteria: All OER sources used in the plan passed the license gate (teacher-lesson-plans-license-003) with committed PASS artifacts: permitsDerivatives: true established from a cited clause/URL, shareAlike and nonCommercial booleans recorded, license snapshot committed (copy + SHA-256 + Wayback URL), and complete attribution blocks present.

The pedagogy/standards reviewer (teacher-lesson-plans-reviewer-002) signed off: objectives are sound and age-appropriate, standards alignment is correct (no fabricated alignments), procedure is teachable in the stated time, answer key (if present) is correct, and UDL/differentiation is present and meaningful.

The plan is schema-valid against the canonical template (teacher-lesson-plans-template-001) and passes all automated checks from teacher-lesson-plans-validator-006: reading level within grade band, attribution complete, metadata valid, links resolve, accessibility structure present.
The plan is exported to Markdown (canonical) and print-ready PDF or HTML.
The plan is delivered to a pilot teacher (who confirms they will teach it) or accepted by an open repository for reuse — with adoption evidence committed to the outcome ledger.
If no adoption channel is yet available, the plan is published openly with the adoption blocker explicitly surfaced and verifiedNeed left false.
Commit is DCO signed-off; no secrets or PII in committed files.
resources: teacher-lesson-plans-template-001 — canonical lesson-plan schema and authoring template
teacher-lesson-plans-license-003 — OER license gate checklist + composed-license rule
OER sources: OpenStax, CK-12, OER Commons, Curriki, Siyavula
output: One complete, schema-valid lesson plan committed to the repo in Markdown + YAML front-matter, with committed license-gate artifacts, reviewer sign-off record, PDF/HTML export, and adoption evidence in the outcome ledger (or an explicit blocker note if adoption is pending).
